title: Rating Algorithm
description: SPM Rating v1.2.0 model variant: SPM Rating v1.2.0-Detailed is the full model, SPM Rating v1.2.0-Compact the lighter one. Both use the same RC/LN sub-model and their own dan tables; changing this updates the current chart, reusing a matching local cache entry when available

title: Sub Difficulty Scheme
description: RC/LN sub-ratings source: Direct uses the new RC/LN sub-algorithms for every chart; Legacy v0.5.1 shows LN difficulty = total

title: Local Analysis Cache
description: Save compressed analysis to local browser storage (up to 64 MiB / 1024 charts). Check .osu contents before reuse; edits invalidate old variants and analyser version changes clear all. Turning off clears the cache

title: UI Style
description: Rating first: the star rating is the headline number. Dan first: the dan value is the headline and the star rating moves next to it. Minimal: dans, overall tags and a live segment readout (BPM, pattern and dan) without stars, graph or timeline

title: Panel Density
description: Standard is full-size; Compact is tighter; Low profile keeps the full-mode graph and timeline in a shorter layout. Short browser viewports use Low profile automatically

title: Color Scheme
description: Overlay palette. Aurora is the new v1.0.1 theme; High Contrast is tuned for readability over bright gameplay

title: Dan Display Style
description: Within-dan position: three segments (low/high), signs (-/+) or decimal number (+0.5 shift: 8.5 = 8dan, 11.5 = Gamma in 7K)

title: Curve Smoothing
description: Softens the difficulty curve. Off draws raw per-400 ms values; Medium now matches the previous Light setting

title: UI Animations
description: Enable smooth digit rolling (BPM, ratings, segment stats), curve morphing, and UI transitions. Turn off to minimize GPU/CPU usage

title: Hide While Playing
description: Hide the overlay after gameplay starts (results screen is shown again)

title: Show Map Summary
description: Display the song, difficulty name, mapper, key count, BPM, object count and length at the top of the panel

title: Show Pattern Tags
description: Display overall pattern tag chips below the rating

title: Show Current Segment
description: Display the live segment tag and equivalent bpm at the playhead

title: Show Segment Difficulty
description: Display the segment dan and, outside Minimal, its star rating for 4K/6K/7K; needs Show Current Segment

title: Show Segment Timeline
description: Display the full-map segment tag color band with playhead

title: Show Break Segments
description: Display 'Break' text during rest sections (timeline always shows them faded)
